result.topic_en: A personal memorandum page recording payment of the half-yearly salary of the observatory director in 1836, a list of numbered bonds or lottery entries with amounts and marks, a small table, a note on Baden bonds held by the author's mother-in-law, and a French quotation on Daguerre's photographic processes.

items.english: The new processes (of Daguerre) are distinguished by economy, a kind of merit which, be it said in passing, rarely goes together with the perfection of the products.
